title: A familiar rule in new circumstances

captions.energy: Seeking a foundation in reliable knowledge

meaning: Reliable knowledge can support your shared view when a new circumstance is allowed to refine a familiar rule.
text: A familiar explanation can be a useful return point while you explore something new together. The Hierophant in the physical position of Ajna describes reading rules, discussing learned ideas and using a shared language of knowledge. The Hierophant in energy has a different role: respect for a reliable foundation and a wish to understand its meaning. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions makes understanding mobile. A familiar framework suddenly fits differently, bringing interest or a brief loss of accustomed certainty. Familiar language can help you explore while keeping your interest in the unfamiliar alive.

For example, assembling a simple shelf, you find a familiar sequence in the instructions but one part looks different. You can consult the particular version of the diagram instead of arguing from memory. **Reliable knowledge stays alive when it meets a new case.** The small difference offers a chance to understand the principle more precisely. Your earlier experience remains useful while you see where today's task needs an adjustment.

The difficulty is continuing to explain the rule after its application has become the question. The more persuasive the familiar words, the harder it becomes to acknowledge a small mismatch. Discussion circles while the relevant piece lies in front of you. Your shared view benefits when an established principle helps you look at the object and leaves its actual details visible.
